name: Pixelmole – Follow-up emails
author: Pixelmole

sections.description:
This plugin lets you send automatic WooCommerce follow-up emails after a purchase, without complex automation tools.

Easily configure the sender, subject, content, and delay from a simple settings screen. Preview your email live, send test emails, and fine-tune the timing to match your workflow.

Ideal for order confirmations, thank-you emails, review requests, or simple post-purchase follow-ups.

Requires WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Features

✅ Send automatic follow-up emails after WooCommerce orders

✅ Choose when to send: immediately or after a custom delay

✅ Live email preview while editing

✅ Send test emails before going live

✅ Custom sender name, sender email, subject, and message

✅ Use placeholders like {{site_name}}, {{site_url}}, {{customer_first_name}}, {{customer_last_name}}

✅ Enable or disable follow-up emails at any time

✅ View follow-up email status directly in the WooCommerce orders table

✅ Built-in feedback button to share ideas or report issues

✅ Works with WP Mail SMTP, Mailpit, or any SMTP setup

What makes this plugin different?

You may have seen other plugins that offer email automation or follow-up emails for WooCommerce. This plugin takes a different approach:

✅ Built for simplicity
This plugin focuses on one thing: sending clear, reliable follow-up emails after a purchase, without complex automation builders or marketing jargon.

✅ Modern and lightweight
Designed for current versions of WordPress and WooCommerce, with clean, modern code and minimal overhead.

✅ No unnecessary features
Every feature is added with care to keep the plugin fast, easy to understand, and easy to maintain.

✅ Live preview and test emails
See exactly how your email looks before sending it, and send test emails to verify your setup.

✅ WooCommerce-first experience
Follow-up email status is visible directly in the WooCommerce orders table, so everything stays where store owners expect it.

✅ No nags or admin ads
No banners, upsells, or review nags cluttering your WordPress admin: just a clean, focused interface.

This plugin is actively developed and improved based on real user feedback.

Have questions or ideas? Use the built-in feedback button, your input helps shape the plugin!

Disclaimer

Use this plugin at your own risk. Always test on a staging site first.
sections.installation:
1. Upload pixelmole-follow-up-emails to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Follow-up emails to configure.
